text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a research paper, not a review. Its primary focus is on modeling the environmental impacts (GHG, water, land use) of hypothetical dietary shifts in India. While it uses land use (LU) data as an *input* and calculates changes in LU footprint, it does NOT perform spatial LULC prediction or simulation. The study does not model, project, or map future land use/land cover changes; it only calculates aggregated land area requirements based on dietary consumption data. It fails the core inclusion criterion: "Primary focus = LULC prediction/simulation (central research question)." The land use analysis is a secondary, non-spatial calculation of footprint.)
